LASER COSMETIC TEETH WHITENING

Get instant results with cosmetic teeth whitening at Luna Moon Aesthetics Preston! We can take your teeth up to 8-12 shades whiter than your natural tooth shade by utilising a laser light to enhance the whiteness of teeth. Luna Moon Aesthetics is a Preston based clinic offering everything you need to keep you looking and feeling glamorous for that special occasion in your life. We are at 55-56 Friargate, Preston, PR1 2AT. Please visit our online booking form for services and availability. We hope to see you soon.

TEETH WHITENING SERVICES

NATURAWHITE SMILE YOUR BEST SMILE

Treat yourself to safe, effective teeth whitening at Luna Moon Aesthetics clinic in Preston. Laser cosmetic teeth whitening is a procedure that uses a teeth whitening gel and powerful laser light to improve the appearance of teeth by lightening their colour by up to 12 shades.

WHAT WE DO

PROFESSIONAL TEETH WHITENING PRESTON

Luna Moons Professional Teeth Whitening service at our clinic in Preston is the quickest and safest and most cost-effective way to improve your radiant smile and look and feel confident. We can help remove stains that have built up over the years and take your teeth up to 8-12 shades whiter. Please note, multiple treatments may be required as results may vary from person to person.
  • No recovery time
  • Treatment time-1 hour
  • Immediate visible results
  • Result Duration Permanent

AESTHETIC SERVICES PRESTON

SPREAD THE LOVE WITH A LUNA MOON SMILE.

When you arrive for your first treatment, we will carry out an initial consultation. The teeth whitening procedure is painless and takes an hour.

We apply a teeth whitening gel to your teeth and this results in the release of oxygen ions, this gently removes stains from your teeth.

We then use a powerful laser to optimise the stain removal process. At the end of the treatment, you will see a visible improvement in the whiteness of your teeth.
